name: sap-dev-tech-radar
description: Tech radar for SAP Devs. Visualizing the SAP developer technology choices.

scripts.prestart: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run conv && npm run build:app
scripts.test:ctrf: npm run test:junit && junit-to-ctrf radar/qa/reports/junit.xml -o radar/qa/reports/ctrf-report.json -t "node:test"
scripts.test:allure: npm run test:junit && allure generate radar/qa/reports -o radar/qa/allure --clean
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:toml
scripts.lint:js: eslint convert.js index.js history.js release-data.js sbom.js test/*.js
scripts.docs: npm run docs:conv && npm run docs:app
scripts.qa: npm run test:coverage && npm run test:ctrf && npm run test:allure && npm run docs && npm run sbom
